description:
This image is a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Core web application, specifically showing the user interface for managing and publishing a data ingestion named 'UA18_IBK'. The main screen displays "General Information" for the ingestion on the left, an interactive map preview on the right, and a "Publish Ingestion 'UA18_IBK'" modal dialog centrally overlaid.

The "General Information" panel shows:
*   Name: UA18_IBK
*   Country: Austria/Österreich
*   Region: Tirol
*   Reference Year: 2018
*   Time Range of Ingested Data: 01.01.2018 - 31.12.2018
*   INSPIRE Themes: LU Land use, LC Land cover
*   Created By: User Admin/Support CLC+ Core
*   Organisation/s: European Environment Agency (EEA)
*   Contact Person: -

Above this panel, the current status is "INGESTED_PREVIEW". Buttons at the top right of the main screen include "START INGESTION" and "PUBLISH".

The map preview section displays an area covering parts of Austria and Italy, centered on Tirol. It features labels like Kufstein, Innsbruck, Schwaz, Mayrhofen, Mittersill, Lienz, Brixen-Bressanone, and Schlanders-Silandro. It includes zoom controls (+ and -), country and region filters ("AT Austria/Österreich" and "AT33 Tirol"), and a "PREVIEW" button. A scale bar shows "20 km" and "10 mi". The map's data source is attributed to "Leaflet | EEA Copernicus programme, German Aerospace Center (DLR) | CC-BY 3.0". Below the map, an "Input Classes" panel shows columns for "Class Code", "Name *", "EAGLE Elements *", "100% EAGLE compliant" (with a checkbox), "Colour", and "Show in Map" (with a checkbox).

The modal dialog, titled "Publish Ingestion 'UA18_IBK'", explains that publishing will make the dataset accessible to other CLC+ Core users. It includes a "Visibility" dropdown set to "Public - All Organisations". A warning states: "Please be aware that it is possible to edit an Ingestion until it is used within an Extraction in status "EXTRACTED". Once it is used in an Extraction, the status of the Ingestion will change to "USED"." The dialog offers "CANCEL" and "PUBLISH" buttons.
